scientific_integrity: Every finite-field and dimension statement is established by an explicit proof, supported by independently implemented exhaustive checks in small cases. No claims of independent expert review or publication priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the free nilpotency-class-two Lie algebra with at least three generators, not to arbitrary nilpotent quotients, conjugacy orbits, or higher classes. Its literature-priority conclusion remains limited to inspected sources; older equivalent rank enumerations cannot be excluded.
title: Rank gaps and exact endomorphism counts for free class-two Lie algebras
